intervention.message: Keep logging screen time; Meika needs a few weeks before it can look for a link.

factors.label: Not enough data yet
factors.detail: This needs at least 28 tracked days with screen time logged on 8 or more of them; you have 0 tracked day(s) and 0 with a session. With less, a correlation would mostly reflect chance, so none is reported.

limitations: Association, not causation. Mood, boredom, payday or a stressful week can drive both screen time and spending; weekly rhythm is removed, other rhythms are not.
Exposure is self-reported. Days with nothing logged are treated as zero exposure, so gaps in logging weaken any link Meika can find.
Meika has no access to social-media or app-usage data. Everything here comes from what you logged.
With a few weeks of data, permutation p-values are coarse: with n days, the smallest possible p is about 1/(n - 14).
Only the same-day-or-next-day test was fixed in advance. The per-lag and per-kind numbers are exploratory and not corrected for multiple comparisons.
Discretionary spending means cafes & dining, apparel and electronics, the same impulse-prone set the early-warning module uses.
